notes.manas-2010:p0875:b001:l012: бутта weighing by poods, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бутта/. Rendered by weight without invented quantity or conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p0875:b001:l036: ырапыс rep/ribbed cloth, edition glossary1844:l006. Blue cloth description retained beside earlier blue-iron armor; no silent material harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0871:b001:l034: Narrator describes Kanykey preparing to fight Chubak and calls her ill-fated twice nearby; no moral accusation. Pre-marriage episode, so do not specifically call her bereaved. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation. Sources: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf; research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json.
